subject: nereid-origin
q: Marianne, Cassandra and twelve daughters have no records of their own.
detail:
They live inside a system entry because the Archive's girls collection is built around Haven residency and a devotion-locked pairing, and this family sits outside all three houses. Marianne and Cassandra are a MARRIED COUPLE and would be a clean couple record; the twelve daughters are a generation the Archive has no shape for at all. Also unwritten: Cassandra's surname, whether any daughter is named, and whether NINE BORN-AFFIRMED TO THREE BORN CIS is a rule of the bloodline or simply how it fell.

UPDATE 7 SEPTEMBER. ALL TWELVE DAUGHTERS ARE NAMED — four sets of triplets, nine born shemale and three born female, with the naming method for each set. See c-hathaway-daughters.

AND THAT IS ALL THERE IS GOING TO BE FOR NOW. MARIANNE AND CASSANDRA ARE TIGHT-LIPPED ABOUT THEM. The two women who built the door every affirmed girl in this canon walked through have twelve daughters and are not discussing them, which is itself a fact worth holding. The Archive records the names, records the silence, and does not fill the gap.
